decisions.reason: Contract 1.1 carries nullability, const, maxLength, uniqueItems, allOf, embeddings and up to 2000 definitions, so the full Elephant graph fits in one extension.
The contract requires one local top vertex. Reachability from that vertex is not enforced by the current compiler.
The viewer lexicon does not declare Model identity properties, so every local vertex uses content-hash identity.
These labels belong to model-shared-base-v1.5.0. An extension cannot redeclare them, so Elephant fields on these classes stay only in lexicon.json.

decisions.rule: <from>__<name> for one target; <from>__<name>__<target> for each of several targets
decisions.reason: Persist edges have exactly one from and one to label, so a relationship with several targets becomes one edge per target.

decisions.rule: relationship_type, with the from and to declared by the data group
decisions.reason: Transform languages emit data-group relationship keys exactly as relationship_type, so the edge label matches them.

decisions.rule: when one relationship_type declares several endpoint pairs, keep the single pair named <from>_has_<to>; otherwise fail
decisions.reason: A Persist edge label has one endpoint pair. The other pairs are source defects and are listed in omittedRelationships.
